methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Cabinet secretary: Southside county loses two economic development prospects due to uncertainty over data center taxes
signals.signal_reading: Tax uncertainty blocking data center investment in Greensville County demonstrates how policy instability prevents historically underserved regions from capturing AI infrastructure opportunities, reinforcing rather than bridging the metro-rural divide.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals potential for distributed capacity-building through local institutions, though success depends on whether training creates deep AI fluency or shallow platform usage.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern deploying specialized AI for industrial defect detection demonstrates deep technical application in Hampton Roads' transportation sector, but remains concentrated in enterprise operations rather than distributed workforce capability.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly targets education and community impact beyond the university, creating potential peer-to-peer learning networks that could distribute AI fluency across Richmond's broader workforce rather than concentrating it in tech enclaves.

signals.title: Kennedy: NextEra-Dominion’s AI future could reshape Virginia’s economy — and its energy politics
signals.signal_reading: NextEra-Dominion deal reshaping energy infrastructure from NoVA to Southside reveals how AI's energy demands concentrate power generation planning around metro data center hubs, potentially widening economic opportunities between regions with different infrastructure readiness.
